tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The following are the General Conditions of Contract for supply of Groceries to all the Hostels of the University of Mysore, Mysuru as per the specifications given in the document. The Goods supplied by the successful Bidder should be of good quality, and should specify the Brand name wherever necessary as mentioned in tender document.

The successful Bidder shall supply all items to all the hostels as per particulars provided in Section-V. No separate amount will be paid for transportation and delivery to the destination and all these shall include in the rate to be quoted along with taxes.
The Purchaser deserves the right to give indent as per his requirements.

The Purchaser Reserves the right at the time of issuing a Supply Order to increase or decrease by up to 25% of the Quantity of goods Originally specified in the schedule of Requirements without any change in unit price or other Terms and Conditions.

It is mandatory that the bidder should quote for every item. If the rates are not quoted for any of the item the financial bid will be evaluated as per clause (18.4) of PRELIMINARY EXAMINATION instruction to bidders and payment for supply will also be made accordingly.
Interested bidders can get the information through the following web portal : http://kppp.karnataka.gov.in
The uploaded scanned documents should be sealed and signed
The tenders are liable for rejection if any of the above said requirements are not complied with.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The University shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
Tenders from joint ventures are not acceptable
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The bidder shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his/her tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing e-procurement portal.

The University of Mysore does not bind itself to accept the lowest bidder and this university reserves the right to Accept or Reject any of the tender or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.
IMP: If necessary, a team may visit your premises for inspection.
The Tenders shall be duly signed by the Tenderer using the Digital Signature certificate (D.S.C)

At any time prior to the deadline for submission of bids, the purchaser may, for any reason, whether at its own initiative or in response to a clarification requested by a prospective bidder, may modify the bidding documents by amendment. The amendment will be notified in e-portal.

Bidders who have received the bidding documents and will be binding on them. In order to allow prospective bidders reasonable time in which to take the amendment into account in preparing their bid, the purchaser may, at its discretion, extend the deadline for the submission of bids

The following are the General Conditions of Contract for supply of Groceries to all the Hostels of the University of Mysore, Mysuru as per the specifications given in the document at format -XI. The Goods supplied by the successful Bidder should be of good quality, and should specify the Brand name wherever necessary as mentioned in format -XI.

The Bidders shall submit Complete Price Schedule as in the e-portal. The Rates should be actual and nearest to the market rates. The bidders should not quote the Freak Rates. If the Freak Rates found below or above 15% for each item theTender will be rejected. Additional deposit will be taken. The Tender Inviting Authority shall reserve its rights in order to determine the Freak Rate vis-a-vis the market rate and to resolve with respect to acceptance of the Tender
Any kind of manipulation/removal of MRP from the packets/bags of Articles will be viewed as the violation of the Tender Agreement
The Articles supplied must be the same as the samples provided and accepted by the Technical Committee at the time of tender Evaluation

The period of this tender is only for One year. On the recommendation of the technical committee & authorities concerned, as well as on the basis of requirement, tender may be extended for a required period as per clause (10.3) of TENDER VALIDITY instruction to bidders

Payments will be made to the Successful Bidder after submission of bills based on the financial conditions of the university. Successful Bidder should be capable to supply Groceries without fail, even after any payment delays.

If the Successful Bidder fails to supply the groceries to the hostels in whole or part within stipulated time after submission of Indent, groceries will be purchased from open market and two times the corresponding bill will be recovered from Successful Bidder or corresponding amount will be deducted from bills of the Successful Bidder
Successful Bidder should submit bills only through Tappal

Interested eligible bidders may furnish the Technical and Commercial Bids for supply of Groceries. The bidder should quote the rates item - wise including the package, transportation, delivering, loading and unloading including GST, service tax & other taxes applicable etc., complete inclusive of all incidental charges to the destination i.e., to all the Hostels of University of Mysore, coming under the jurisdiction of Mysuru city.
The successful bidder shall furnish Performance Security/Security Deposit at 5% on contract value in the form of Bank Guarantee/Fixed Deposit/Demand Draft drawn in favor of Finance Officer, UoM.
The successful bidder must give a form of warranty for the quality of the Groceries supplied.

Interested bidders may obtain further information or clarification either in person or through phone during office hours at Directorate of Student Welfare, University of Mysore, Manasagangotri, Mysuru and also may contact through telephone No.. : 0821-2419386.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
The cost of the Tender Processing shall not be refundable.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government / Government of India /Union Territory.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing e-procurement portal.
The University of Mysore does not bind itself to accept the lowest bidder and this university reserves the right to Accept or Reject any of the tender or all the tenders without assigning any reasons

At any time prior to the deadline for submission of bids, the purchaser may, for any reason, whether at its own initiative or in response to a clarification requested by a prospective bidder, may modify the bidding documents by amendment. The amendment will be notified in e-portal.

Bidders who have received the bidding documents and will be binding on them. In order to allow prospective bidders reasonable time in which to take the amendment into account in preparing their bid, the purchaser may, at its discretion, extend the deadline for the submission of bids.

The EMD & Tender processing fee shall be paid through e-procurement portal only using any of the four modes. 1) Credit Card. 2) Direct debit using Internet banking 3) NEFT( National electronic fund transfer 4) OTC (Over the counter using bank challan).
IMP: Bidders should read all the terms and condition which is uploaded separately with specification details before bidding.
For more details regarding registration in e-procurement cell, please contact e-procurement help desk Ph: 08046010000 / 08068948777 from 9.00 a.m. to 9.00 p.m. on all working days.
Very Imp: BIDDER SHOULD GO THROUGH THE TENDER DOCUMENT WHICH WAS UPLOADED THOURGHLY BEFORE SUBMITTING THE TENDER.

Interested bidders may obtain further information or clarification either in person or through phone during office hours at Directorate of Student Welfare, University of Mysore, Manasagangotri, Mysuru and also may contact through telephone nos. : 0821 -2419386.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have executed at least one similar supply (Groceries) contract of value not less than 80% of the amount put tender (i.e. 80% of Rs. 7,72,00,000/- in any one of the last three financial years i.e., 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 to government Organization/ Govt. Aided Institution

The bidder should submit at least Five satisfactory Certificates for supplies to the government Organization/ Govt. Aided Institution for having supplied not less than Rs.1 crore of similar Groceries individual supply contract Certified by competent Gazette officer along with purchase order. In any of the last three financial years i.e., 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26. The Bidder in this regard shall furnish duly certified Work Order along with the Experience Certificate. The Bidder shall upload, along with its bid, copies of work orders and corresponding satisfactory completion/ performance certificates issued by the concerned authority in respect of similar contracts executed for any Government Department, Semi-Government Organisation, Government Autonomous Body, Statutory Authority, Public Sector Undertaking, or other Government- controlled entity. The satisfactory completion/ performance certificate shall specifically relate to the work order submitted and shall evidence that the contract was executed satisfactorily in accordance with the terms and conditions thereof. Mere submission of a work order without the corresponding satisfactory completion/ performance certificate shall not be considered sufficient for the purpose of meeting this eligibility requirement. Further, the work order relied upon by the Bidder for establishing eligibility must have been awarded through a transparent tendering process conducted in accordance with the provisions of the Karnataka Transparency in Public Procurements Act, 1999, and the rules made there under, or through an equivalent public procurement framework applicable to the concerned Government, Semi-Government, or Government Autonomous Body. The Bidder shall furnish such documentary evidence as may be required by the Tender Inviting Authority to substantiate compliance with this requirement.
Bidder shall be a company, firm, and individual proprietorship, Non-governmental Organization who are registered under law under any Government competent authority shall furnish the copy.
